desc: Need colors that go together? Here are the six from my painting of Mr. Chew the snail “Coffee to go”: Poppy, Lemon, Chestnut, Ink Black, Pigeon Grey and Duck Egg. A balanced combination for watercolor, gouache or digital art. HEX codes on pigeonpolly.com.
alt: Six watercolor swatches (Poppy, Lemon, Chestnut, Ink Black, Pigeon Grey, Duck Egg) below “Coffee to go”, a painting of Mr. Chew the snail by Pigeon Polly.
